meta.title: Relocated catalogue, 2026 South Kona (Hawaii) sequence and Pahala swarm
meta.method: Machine-learning relocated catalogue of the 2026 Mw 5.9 South Kona (Hawaii) sequence and the concurrent Pahala swarm, 23 Apr - 10 Jun 2026 (LOC-FLOW: PhaseNet, REAL, HYPOINVERSE, hypoDD with catalog + cross-correlation differential times, 1-D Klein-family velocity model).
meta.citation: Meng group, preliminary relocations; manuscript in preparation (2026), not peer reviewed.
meta.notes: Magnitude is the network ML used as a proxy. lon, lat, depth_km, mag (network ML proxy), time_utc
